correctness.rationale: For positive sigma,gamma, 0<beta_L<beta_H, and positive high/low block durations, H=exp(t_H G_high), L=exp(t_L G_low), G_b=[[-sigma,b],[sigma,-gamma]], are strictly positive 2x2 matrices. Across all 20 words with 3 H and 3 L, cyclic trace/class reduction yields HHHLLL (6 words), HHLHLL (12), HLHLHL (2). Cayley–Hamilton gives exact tr(H²LHL²)-tr(H³L³)=tr(H)tr(L)K and tr((HL)³)-tr(H²LHL²)=tr(HL)K, K=-det[H,L]. Because [H,L]=u_H u_L[G_bH,G_bL] and det[G_bH,G_bL]=-sigma²(beta_H-beta_L)², K>0. At common positive determinant, Perron root strictly grows with trace, proving strict ordering clustered<middle<alternating. For beta_L<gamma, as beta_H varies from beta_L upward each multiplier increases strictly from <1 to infinity, giving strict ordered unique thresholds. Independent symbolic Cayley–Hamilton tests and all 20 word classes checked; numeric example matched but infinite range rests on algebra and positivity.
